mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide may increase photosensitivity risk and minocycline is a known photosensitizing tetracycline; additionally, thiazide diuretics can cause electrolyte abnormalities and dehydration that may potentiate minocycline's nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes; counsel patient on enhanced photosensitivity precautions including strict sun protection and avoidance of UV exposure; ensure adequate hydration.
